description: Schedule a maintenance window that silences alerts for the given uptime checks (by id and/or tag). start_at/end_at are RFC3339; only the date and time are used and are read as local time in `timezone`. At least one of tests or tags is required. Only works on accounts using the newer maintenance-windows feature. StatusCake: POST /maintenance-windows.

repeat_interval.description: How often it repeats: never, 1d, 1w, 2w or 1m.

tags.description: Include every uptime check carrying these tags.

timezone.description: IANA timezone the times are read in, e.g. UTC or Europe/London.

name: statuscake_create_maintenance_window
title: Create a maintenance window
